checks.custom_hooks_enabled: Warn about Kea hooks no package owns
checks.resolver_drop_min_per_minute: Query drop: minimum queries per minute
checks.resolver_roots_failures: Root probe failures in a row
checks.advisories_fetch_enabled: Fetch advisory data from the network

collector.live_seconds: Live pass: HA heartbeats and lease watch
collector.lease_watch_max_leases: Lease watch: largest lease table walked

dns.default_ns: Name servers of new primary zones

certificates.retry_min_seconds: First retry after a failed request

auth.session_ttl_seconds: A session ends this long after sign-in, active or not.
auth.login_rate_limit_per_minute: Per client address; more get 429 until the minute ends.
auth.require_totp: Users without TOTP may only enrol until they do.

plans.ttl_seconds: A plan not applied within this delay expires.

peers.plan_timeout_seconds: Engine plans applied or rolled back on another node.
peers.installer_plan_timeout_seconds: Install, import and security plans: packages and restarts take longer.
peers.action_timeout_seconds: Plan builds and runtime operations this node asks of another.

checks.pool_warning_percent: Use of a pool that raises pool_near_full; below the critical value.
checks.forecast_window_days: Days of pool samples the trend is computed from.
checks.d2_error_percent: Share of failed DNS updates of kea-dhcp-ddns that raises d2_errors.
checks.serial_divergence_seconds: A secondary may lag the primary this long before secondary_stale.
checks.ha_grace_seconds: A partner-down or degraded state shorter than this raises nothing (restarts, failovers).
checks.clock_skew_warning_seconds: Also the limit the HA repair plan checks before it restarts HA.
checks.clock_skew_critical_seconds: Kea terminates HA at 60 s: keep it below.
checks.cert_warning_days: Web, node and CA certificates; short-lived ones use a share of their lifetime.
checks.resolver_min_queries: Fewer answers in the window: no resolver alert.
checks.advisories_fetch_enabled: Off: the data shipped with the package, or a file placed by hand.

collector.lease_watch_max_leases: Larger tables are not watched live (0 turns the watch off).

dns.view_keys: A view other than _default is reached with its own TSIG key: the update key, and a transfer key when it differs.
dns.default_ttl_seconds: When a record is written without a TTL.

rpz.shrink_percent: A download that removes more of a list is refused; the old file stays.
rpz.memory_warning_percent: Estimated share of a node memory the lists may take.
